scope_cn: 国债价格变动及波动率假设改变所需保证金。
scope_en: Assumed Treasury price moves/volatility alter required margin.
not_modeled_cn: 未复制VaR、组合净额、真实GSD头寸或保证金通知。
not_modeled_en: No production VaR/netting, actual GSD portfolio or requirement notices.

scope_cn: 假设MBS因子变动改变VM现金及所需保证金。
scope_en: An assumed MBS factor move changes VM cash and required margin.
not_modeled_cn: 未分离利率、利差、凸性及真实TBA交易。
not_modeled_en: No separate rate/spread/convexity model or real TBA trades.

scope_cn: 假设股价变动转为会员VM支付与收款。
scope_en: Assumed equity moves become member VM payments and receipts.
not_modeled_cn: 未模拟实际NSCC结算时序或会员资金网络。
not_modeled_en: No actual NSCC settlement timing or member funding network.

scope_cn: 假设波动率改变Clearing Fund要求及增量现金需求；与VM分列。
scope_en: Assumed volatility changes Clearing Fund requirements and incremental cash needs, separate from VM.
not_modeled_cn: 未复制NSCC保证金公式或证明真实追加通知。
not_modeled_en: No production NSCC margin formula or evidence of actual calls.

scope_cn: 同一会员证券集中度改变假设保证金加收。
scope_en: Single-member security concentration alters a hypothetical margin add-on.
not_modeled_cn: 未验证资本承压、官方阈值、真实会员或实际风控决定。
not_modeled_en: No observed capital strain, official thresholds, real member or risk decision.

scope_cn: 最大关联家族流动性敞口转为假设补充存款追缴及未覆盖缺口。
scope_en: Largest affiliated-family liquidity exposure produces illustrative deposit calls and uncovered gaps.
not_modeled_cn: 未复制Rule 4(A)公式、动态需求、实际SLD通知及真实资源。
not_modeled_en: No Rule 4(A) formula, dynamic needs, actual SLD calls or real resources.

scope_cn: 国债和期货带符号敞口在假设相关性下改变组合风险及所需金额。
scope_en: Signed Treasury/futures exposures alter combined risk and requirement under assumed correlation.
not_modeled_cn: 未模拟真实项目资格、机构间分配、清盘或GSD官方RFD。
not_modeled_en: No actual program eligibility, inter-CCP allocation, liquidation or official GSD RFD.

scope_cn: 违约后自有资源与剩余损失的假设分配
scope_en: Conditional own-resource use and toy residual allocation after activated default
not_modeled_cn: 未复制官方损失瀑布、评估周期、法定分摊上限或违约发生率
not_modeled_en: Does not reproduce official waterfall, assessment periods, legal caps or default incidence

scope_cn: 假设多空头寸在延迟平仓中的不利价格变化
scope_en: Adverse repricing of hypothetical long/short positions during delayed close-out
not_modeled_cn: 未建模实际CNS头寸、买入成交深度、真实市场路径或违约发生率
not_modeled_en: No actual CNS positions, buy-in depth, historical paths or default incidence

scope_cn: 虚拟分配单位的现金与抵押品共同到期门槛
scope_en: Joint cash/collateral deadlines on hypothetical allocation units
not_modeled_cn: 未计算官方费用；未复制GCF净头寸方向与实际日内优化
not_modeled_en: No official fees; no production GCF position-side netting or intraday optimization

scope_cn: 已假设净额后的发行日现金义务集中
scope_en: Concentration of assumed netted issue-date cash obligations
not_modeled_cn: 未估计拍卖尾差因果作用、实际获配、证券交付或净额率
not_modeled_en: No auction-tail causal estimate, actual awards, security-delivery leg or netting ratio

scope_cn: DTC专属虚拟银行映射与日终确认门槛
scope_en: DTC-only hypothetical bank mapping and end-day acknowledgement gate
not_modeled_cn: 未复制Fedwire交易、真实结算银行应急安排或银行违约概率
not_modeled_en: No actual Fedwire transfers, bank contingency arrangements or default probability

scope_cn: NSCC专属虚拟银行映射与日终确认门槛
scope_en: NSCC-only hypothetical bank mapping and end-day acknowledgement gate
not_modeled_cn: 未复制Fedwire交易；未将DTC结果直接用于NSCC
not_modeled_en: No actual Fedwire transfers; DTC outcomes are not transferred to NSCC

scope_cn: 假设IPA对发行人简称的融资确认门控，区分到期与发行指令。
scope_en: Hypothetical IPA funding acknowledgement by acronym, with separate maturity and issuance instructions.
not_modeled_cn: 未复制MMI优化、PIF、真实IPA融资确认或付款失败频率；融资确认不是实际结算成功的充分条件。
not_modeled_en: No MMI optimization, PIF, real IPA acknowledgements or calibrated failure frequency; acknowledgement is not sufficient for actual settlement success.

scope_cn: 券商退出引起的假设账户转移集中到达与处理队列。
scope_en: Hypothetical broker-exit transfer arrivals and processing queue.
not_modeled_cn: 未复制ACATS真实时限、全部状态、参与者违约后的撤销、账户资产可转移性及券商映射。
not_modeled_en: No actual ACATS deadlines, full state machine, participant-default reversals, asset transferability or broker mapping.

scope_cn: 分别生成申购赎回总订单，模拟处理能力与独立赎回预付资金约束。
scope_en: Separate purchase/redemption gross orders, processing capacity and independently prefunded redemption cash.
not_modeled_cn: 未复制真实基金净值、净额结算、订单规则及基金或分销商映射。
not_modeled_en: No actual NAVs, payment netting, order rules or fund/distributor mappings.

scope_cn: 证券存入必须通过假设的登记确认门控。
scope_en: Deposit instructions require an explicit hypothetical registration confirmation.
not_modeled_cn: 未建模真实发行人、过户代理及证券权属裁定。
not_modeled_en: No real issuer, transfer agent or ownership determination.

scope_cn: 显式证券级存入冻结仅阻止存入，全面锁定阻止所模拟的存入与划转。
scope_en: Explicit security-level deposit chill gates deposits; global lock gates modeled deposits and transfers.
not_modeled_cn: 不从停牌自动推断DTC锁定，未识别真实锁定决定或原因。
not_modeled_en: No automatic lock inference from a trading halt; no actual restriction decision or reason identified.

scope_cn: 单独生成DTC加拿大链接依赖及跨境指令中断。
scope_en: Independently generated DTC Canadian-Link dependencies and interrupted cross-border instructions.
not_modeled_cn: 未建模真实CDS接口、资金外汇腿或NSCC结果；不会继承NSCC路径。
not_modeled_en: No actual CDS interface, cash/FX legs or inherited NSCC outcomes.

scope_cn: 另行生成境外机构链接依赖及NSCC跨境指令中断。
scope_en: Separately generated foreign-institution link dependencies and interrupted NSCC cross-border instructions.
not_modeled_cn: 未复制真实国际链接协议或用DTC结果替代NSCC结果。
not_modeled_en: No actual international-link agreement or substitution of DTC outcomes for NSCC outcomes.
